text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm taking a stroll in the park on my day off, when…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Argh?! Y-you have to be kidding me… Am I in the first circle of hell?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah, my salvation! I beg you, Trainer, rescue me from the misery of these dark depths before I succumb to misfortune!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I was feeling groggy and dozed off on the bench… I only just woke up! That's when…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I heard a crow caw four times above my head! That's definitely a sign things will take a turn for the worse!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: My mom always used to warn me to come back home before the crow's first caw! It means danger is just around the corner!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After an untimely encounter with an omen of misfortune, Matikanefukukitaru seems to be completely drained of energy…
